name: io.github.parthsevak2/curb-cut-mcp
description: Workplace accommodation options, cost evidence and drafts. Looks up and drafts; never sends.

environmentVariables.name: SF_ORG_ALIAS
environmentVariables.description: Salesforce CLI alias of the Curb Cut org. Defaults to curbcut.

environmentVariables.name: CURB_CUT_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this installation's Curb Cut site, quoted when a draft tells the person where they can send it themselves.

environmentVariables.name: TWILIO_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: SMS number of this installation, offered next to the site as another way the person can send for themselves.

environmentVariables.name: CURB_CUT_SUPPORT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Address given when a human handoff cannot be completed.

environmentVariables.name: SF_CLI_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Override for the Salesforce CLI's node_modules/@salesforce directory when the CLI is installed somewhere unusual.
